inspector.text: C02 Commit transport Back to map ↑ A post-commit hook hands off a commit to a detached dispatcher. The dispatcher gathers the committed tree and the context for this run. post-commit -> queue -> settle / coalesce -> parent diff -> scan | Git bundle + envelope -+-> plane Receives Commit SHA, local queue and repository configuration. Does Use the parent comparison, coalesce queued commits and build a Git object pack. Gather selected transcript prose. Scan the latest parent-to-HEAD code blobs and scrub the transcript. Returns A run envelope and uploaded Git pack, followed by a polling process waiting for the result. Runs in Your machine Limits Unsaved work is not submitted. Full seed history usually follows the initial bundle, but the code secret scan covers latest parent-to-HEAD blobs rather than all history. Transcript off does not remove already committed conversation files. Proposed area Developer workflow → cmd/runstory/hook.go internal/dispatch/dispatch.go internal/pack/bundle.go internal/gate

select.text: C08 Ledger and judge Back to map ↑ Probe calls form a ledger. The judge reads that evidence and derives a typed verdict. A later model-written story is a readable explanation of the result. probe start + completion -> local ledger -> Go judge -> verdict.json | | streamed completions later story v plane run_events -> explicit rejudge Receives Ledger, selected route, check catalogue and verified hunt candidates. Does Derive observed check states. Require the selected floor to be accounted for. Render reproducible failure scripts. Validate the story against run evidence. Returns verdict.json with pass, fail or needs_work, plus reproducers. The plane adds completion facts. A story is accepted only after structural and reference validation. Runs in Live judge in sandbox; rejudge wrapper in plane Limits Pass requires at least one pilot turn as well as clean required coverage. A story does not decide pass. Rejudge runs the same Go judge on stored evidence in the plane, but some original novel/regression inputs are not retained. Proposed area Evidence and feedback → internal/judge/judge.go internal/judge/route.go cmd/runstory-runner/cmd_judge.go cmd/runstory-runner/story.go plane/lib/judge/rejudge.ts

first.text: STEP 01 / 15 Install the CLI Build the command from the project checkout and put it on your PATH. The repository includes npm and Homebrew packaging, but this source review does not establish publication. git clone https://github.com/specstoryai/runstory.git cd runstory make install Result The build is linked at ~/.local/bin/runstory. Remember Use the hosted plane URL and deployment bypass secret supplied by the service operator. Keep one account UUID across your repositories. C01 · Repository setup Makefile README.md

second.text: STEP 02 / 15 Initialize a repository Run init inside the Git repository you want checked. Init detects the project and writes local configuration and integration files. cd /path/to/your-project runstory init --account <account-uuid> --bypass <secret> Result runstory.toml, .runstory/plan.json, Git hooks and agent integration files. Remember The account is asserted by the client. This is not an authenticated sign-up or device-login flow. C01 · Repository setup cmd/runstory/init.go

inspector.text: C03 Gateway and command ledger Source implemented A browser action becomes a durable, ordered command before the runner can receive it. Browser intent → auth + origin + protocol + message-only gate → transaction: command + status + event → durable receipt → runner may lease the next command Receives A same-origin authenticated browser request with a stable request ID and bounded message text. Does Parses the public protocol, enforces the message-only policy, rejects unsafe credential-shaped text, assigns identity and ordering, and writes the command and receipt transactionally. Repeated logical requests return the original result. Returns A durable command, delivery status and receipt. Runner attempts are tracked separately from the original browser request. Runs in Fastify gateway and node:sqlite ledger under factoryweb. Current limit Queue/pause/resume implementations exist below the route, but the active route rejects these operations. A successful HTTP receipt means accepted intent, not a Claude reply or project change. ↑ Back to map Proposed product area Identity and command authority → src/http/gateway.ts src/factory-web/control/command-service.ts src/ledger/database.ts src/l

inspector.text: stoa CLI COMPOSED IN SOURCE One Go binary that is both the user-facing CLI and the host for the daemons. INPUT / OUTPUT In: terminal commands. Out: local state changes, RPC calls, cloud queries. RUNS AS The developer's shell process. WHAT IT DOES main.go starts Sentry and analytics, then executes cmd.RootCmd. Commands self-register from their own files; root.go registers fourteen unconditionally. Thirty command files carry //go:build tags (git, llm, advanced, config, diag, web, scribe), so the default build is deliberately slim. CURRENT LIMIT The stoa web meetings/topics/transcripts/notes/projects commands are NOT behind the web tag - only web_collab.go is - so they ship in the slim binary. help_web.go IS tagged, but it only controls the pretty help listing, so in a default build those commands work while staying invisible to stoa --help. SOURCE stoa-cli/main.go stoa-cli/cmd/root.go

select.text: CRDT relay (intent-server) OUTSIDE THIS REPO Merges Automerge documents between every machine and every browser. INPUT / OUTPUT In: wss://intent-relay.specstory.com:7477/ws/{teamId}/{projectHash} with a short-lived token. Out: merged document state. RUNS AS A separately deployed service. ITS SOURCE IS NOT IN THIS REPOSITORY. WHAT IT DOES Both halves of the product connect to it: the browser through IntentServerAdapter, the Go daemon through the stoa:// sync client. Documents persist on the relay's filesystem. CURRENT LIMIT This is the single most common thing a new engineer misses. If you are looking for where document content is stored and cannot find it in Postgres, this is why. Only the client side of the protocol can be read here. SOURCE stoa-web/lib/automerge/IntentServerAdapter.ts stoa-web/lib/contexts/AutomergeRepoContext.tsx
